attested.notes: Full rewrite to the three-clock framework. Scenes: bank statement reconstruction, calls to the mobile stopping, shareholder house purchase, petition arriving while someone is on holiday plus the frozen wages run, the loan account found in month seven, transactions half forgotten, the van sold to a brother-in-law, directors calling 18 months on about a company still listed. Practitioner we carries the appointment range, the delay patterns and the involvement section. Persona warmth at the top (lying awake) and at the decision point (a different life from running a failing company). Asymmetrical lines: most winnable stage most often wasted; enter in a fortnight, close in two years; official data and a practitioner estimate are not the same kind of fact. Whole-page repetition scan run: reduced 'It is the' from 3 to 2 instances. No em dashes.
